info.name: Opereit Invoice Auditing Contracts Invoice Audits API

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per request.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request.

params.name: contract_id
params.description: Filter by the contract used for the audit.

items.docs: Returns a cursor-paginated list of invoice audits.

Upload a carrier invoice and audit it against the rates and surcharges of an existing contract. Returns immediately with `status=PENDING`; auditing runs asynchronously. Poll `GET /v1/invoice-audits` until `status=COMPLETE` to retrieve findings.

Accepted file formats: PDF, CSV.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per request.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request.

params.name: charge_type
params.description: Filter by the kind of charge.

params.name: tracking_number
params.description: Return only line items associated with this tracking number.

params.name: has_finding
params.description: If `true`, return only line items that have at least one finding.

items.docs: Returns a cursor-paginated list of line items (individual shipment charges) extracted from the invoice. Each line item is a single charge — a rate, surcharge, or adjustment — applied to one tracking number.

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of items to return per request.

params.name: cursor
params.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response. Omit on the first request.

params.name: tracking_number
params.description: Return only findings tied to this tracking number.

params.name: excluded
params.description: If `false`, return only active (non-excluded) findings. If `true`, return only excluded findings. Omit to return both.

items.docs: Returns a cursor-paginated list of findings — discrepancies detected between the carrier invoice and the contract. See `AuditFinding.type` for the catalog of finding types.
